adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, the updated calendar-event update flow now falls back to `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: reference.credentialId } })` when `this.calendarCredentials` doesn’t contain that id, then uses the returned credential to call `updateEvent(...)`. This DB fetch is not constrained by ownership (e.g., booking/user/team) and doesn’t check `invalid`, so a booking `reference.credentialId` could cause loading and using an unrelated credential if such an id is present. Previously the code only selected from `this.calendarCredentials` (scoped to the current context), so this is a newly introduced security/correctness risk.
